items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: And that was Hazel Scott, Lee Young and myself. We had a very nice featured spot in that picture.

ctx.x: And that was Hazel Scott, Lee Young and myself. We had a very nice featured spot in that picture. I know it's way before your time, but...
I was going to movies in 1943, but I may not have been aware of whom I was seeing. Your picture credits: The first one, listed in the index, but not listed in the listing, was St. Louis Blues.
